The catalogue modules: AI phone intake, email triage, ticket creation, staff assignment, document data entry, customer status updates. Integrations: CSV export or import, API connector, CRM connector, export-only tools. Pricing: monthly prices, setup fees, integration surcharges, volume tiers, low, base and high estimates. Policies: approvals, personal data, security. The report, the specification, the submission, and the session and account actions (rename, archive, start a new diagnosis, sign out, delete my data).
